name: Lease and Heartbeat Convergence
description: Agents hold leases on tasks. Heartbeats renew leases. Missed heartbeats trigger reassignment.
purpose: Ensure fault-tolerant task ownership: if an agent fails, its assigned tasks are automatically reassigned after lease expiry.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task assignment has a time-bounded lease held by the assigned agent
Heartbeats extend the lease window on a configurable interval
Missed heartbeats cause the lease to expire, making the task available for reassignment
Lease expiry triggers a coordinated handoff or clean reassignment
Lease state is persisted for crash recovery
Heartbeat timing and lease duration are configurable per task type
